2608.11755.title: MuseCritic: Learning Multi-Aspect Song Rewards through Natural-Language Aesthetic Critiques
2608.11755.paper_summary: Long-form song generation models continue to improve in duration, structural integrity, and acoustic complexity, making reliable aesthetic rewards increasingly important for aligning these models with human preferences. However, reward models for complete songs remain limited, and existing evaluators typically predict scores in a single forward pass without providing readable explanations. We introduce MUSECRITIC, a semi-scalar reward model that generates a natural-language critique covering five aesthetic dimensions and uses it as an intermediate representation to predict continuous reward scores. MUSECRITIC follows a two-stage training pipeline: a teacher model first provides high-quality critiques for supervised fine-tuning, after which the fine-tuned model generates its own critiques for reward learning, mitigating distribution shift between training and inference. On an in-domain test set of 200 SongEval songs, MUSECRITIC reduces macro-averaged mean squared error from 0.2875 to 0.2316 and improves macro-averaged LCC, SRCC, and Kendall's tau to 0.9068, 0.8838, and 0.7178, respectively. On the out-of-domain Music Arena benchmark with 733 preference pairs, it achieves the highest accuracy of 71.35%. Moreover, using MUSECRITIC with GRPO improves Muse-0.6B on all nine aesthetic metrics from SongEval and Audiobox Aesthetics. These results demonstrate that critique-conditioned reward modeling reduces scoring error and provides an effective optimization signal for song generation. The project repository is available at https://github.com/WuqnEl/MuseCritic.
2608.11755.paper_summary_zh: 長格式歌曲生成模型在持續改進持續時間、結構完整性和聲學複雜性，使得可靠的美學獎勵對於將這些模型與人類偏好對齊變得越來越重要。<lb/>然而，完整歌曲的獎勵模型仍然有限，現有的評估器通常在單次前向傳遞中預測分數，而不提供可讀的解釋。<lb/>我們介紹了 MUSECRITIC，一種半標量獎勵模型，生成涵蓋五個美學維度的自然語言批評，並將其用作預測連續獎勵分數的中介表示。<lb/>MUSECRITIC 遵循兩階段的訓練流程：教師模型首先提供高質量的批評以進行監督微調，然後經過微調的模型生成自己的批評以進行獎勵學習，減少訓練和推理之間的分佈偏移。<lb/>在 200 首 SongEval 歌曲的內域測試集中，MUSECRITIC 將宏觀平均均方誤差從 0.2875 降低到 0.2316，並將宏觀平均 LCC、SRCC 和 Kendall's tau 分別提高到 0.9068、0.8838 和 0.7178。<lb/>在包含 733 對偏好的外域 Music Arena 基準測試中，它達到了 71.35% 的最高準確率。<lb/>此外，將 MUSECRITIC 與 GRPO 結合使用，改善了 Muse-0.6B 在 SongEval 和 Audiobox Aesthetics 的所有九個美學指標。<lb/>這些結果表明，基於批評的獎勵建模減少了評分誤差，並為歌曲生成提供了有效的優化信號。<lb/>項目代碼庫可在 https://github.com/WuqnEl/MuseCritic 獲得。
